shortDefinition.en: The photographer adjusts focus using the lens focus ring rather than relying on autofocus to set the distance.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 摄影师使用镜头对焦环调整焦点，而不是依赖自动对焦设定距离。

en: Manual focus does not remove the need to check focus; magnification or other aids can help.
zh-cn: 手动对焦仍需检查焦点；放大或其他辅助功能可以帮助判断。

example.en: Manual focus is useful when deliberate control is needed or a low-contrast target makes AF unreliable.
example.zh-cn: 需要主动控制焦点，或低反差目标让 AF 不可靠时，可以使用手动对焦。

sources.title: Autofocus — FUJIFILM X-T5 Owner’s Manual
sources.supports: Manual-focus operation with the lens focus ring and its use when AF cannot focus.
